_doc: STAGING — not merged into data/themes.json yet. Twelve boards for the widened 90s pack, produced by scripts/theme-yield.mjs from the locked vocabulary in data/theme-vocab.json. Every board clears 3-of-5 recognisable rows and no row word is used more than three times across the pack. NOTHING HERE HAS A CANON ENTRY: every clue naming a record, an act or a year is an unverified draft until data/canon.json vouches for it, and npm test is supposed to fail on exactly that. Ten of the twelve bases are claimed by other packs — see `donor` — and each of those packs needs a replacement board authored before this can merge.

theme.name: The Nineties
theme.blurb: R&B, hip-hop, new jack and neo-soul — the decade as it came out of the speakers.
theme._rename: Was '90s R&B'. Narrow R&B supported only 7 boards; widening to the decade took it to 19 at 4-of-5.
